text: This might be silly but I'd rather ask. I'm fostering a 9 month old boy, temp is 38.7. He has some tiny dark red dots on his tummy and side, I pressed a glass on them like you're meant to and they don't go away, I can still see them through it. He also banged his head on the coffee table earlier, cried right away and has been his normal self since. Not sure if the spots are something or nothing.
